visual_action: A fast-paced montage of various Democratic politicians is shown, all with a blue color grading. The video opens and closes with the Democratic Party donkey logo superimposed over an American flag. Clips include Barack Obama speaking, Gavin Newsom laughing, Bernie Sanders laughing, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez smiling, Raphael Warnock waving to a crowd, Nancy Pelosi surrounded by press, and others at rallies and public appearances.
